LanguageData.MX_QH_LuoshenContractMaintained.stages.0: I formed a contract with {PAWN_nameDef} under Luoshen's witness. Being with {PAWN_nameDef} makes me feel at peace.
LanguageData.MX_QH_LuoshenContractBroken.stages.0.des: The contract I maintained with {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} has broken. The flower words that once resonated now echo hollowly.
LanguageData.MX_QH_LuoshenRibbonGrace.stages.0.label: Luoshen's ribbon ({0})
LanguageData.MX_QH_LuoshenRibbonGrace.stages.0.descri: Luoshen's ribbon once drew my heart toward {OTHERPAWN_nameDef}. That gentleness still echoes within me.
